Pattern Sketch

Earth pendulum

A single string with a ball swinging freely. The Earth turns underneath it, so its path slowly turns into a rosette on the floor. This is also called a Foucault pendulum.

A pendulum keeps swinging in the same direction while the floor turns beneath it. Seen from the floor, the swing slowly changes direction, and the path it draws fans out into a rosette.

In real life this takes hours, so the app speeds up the Earth's spin (Earth spin) so you can watch it happen. Latitude sets where on Earth the pendulum hangs: the floor turns fastest at the poles and not at all at the equator. Damping makes the swing slowly shrink.

Touch the ball and drag to place it. Let go to drop it, or sweep to throw it.
